basic_details.job_title: CTUAP Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online

qualification.details: post: Qualification Required | guest faculty (dept. of comp. science): Eligibility (A or B):A. i) A Master's degree with 55% marks (or an equivalent grade in a point-scale wherever the grading system is followed) in a concerned/relevant/allied subject from an Indian University, or an equivalent degree from an accredited foreign university.ii) Besides fulfilling the above qualifications, the candidate must have cleared the National Eligibility Test (NET) conducted by the UGC or the CSIR, or a similar test accredited by the UGC, like SLET/SET or who are or have been awarded a Ph. D. Degree in accordance with the University Grants Commission Regulations, 2009 or 2016 and their amendments from time to time as the case may be exempted from NET/SLET/SET.Note: Candidates registered for Ph.D. prior to July 11, 2009, are governed by certain exemptions as per UGC norms.ORB. The Ph.D. degree has been obtained from a foreign university/institution with a ranking among top 500 in the World University Ranking by any one of the following: (i) Quacquarelli Symonds (QS) (ii) The Times Higher Education (THE) or (iii) The Academic Ranking of World Universities (ARWU) of the Shanghai Jiao Tong University (Shanghai).

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs. 1,500/- per lecture (max. Rs. 50,000/- per month)
salary_details.guest faculty: Rs. 1,500/- per lecture subject to a maximum of Rs. 50,000/- per month vide UGC guidelines No.F.25-1/2018(PS/MISC.) dated 28.01.2019.
salary_details.details: As per F&A rules, 10% or 20% respectively for those with and without PAN may be deducted towards income tax, unless a certificate of exemption from a competent authority is submitted.

selection_process: The engagement of Guest Faculty shall be through Walk-in-Interview.
how_to_apply: Gather scanned copies of relevant documents including all marks sheets, degree certificates, and caste certificate where applicable.
Send the CV and scanned copies of relevant documents through email to [email protected] and a copy to [email protected].
Ensure the application is sent on or before 15 October 2026.
Attend the Walk-in-Interview on 16 October 2026 at 11.00 AM at the venue.

Report at the venue 1 hour prior to the interview time carrying original documents and copies of qualifications, degree, NET certificate, experience certificate, latest caste/EWS certificate, and two recent passport size photographs.
important_instructions: The engagement is purely on a temporary basis for the current academic semester and may be extended further if required. Candidates are requested to report at the venue 1 hour before interview time. No TA/DA shall be paid to the candidates appearing for the walk-in-interview. The superannuated teachers may also be considered for engagement as Guest Faculty subject to a maximum age limit of 70 years. Guest Faculty will not be treated like regular teachers for voting rights or becoming members of statutory bodies. Guest Faculty will not be given the benefit of allowances, pension, gratuity, and leave as admissible to regular teachers. Candidates must provide an undertaking that their submitted publications are free from plagiarism. Qualifications and other conditions are subject to UGC regulations 2018.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CTUAP Guest Faculty
content_sections.text: Prepare your detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV). Gather scanned copies of relevant documents including all marks sheets, degree certificates, and caste certificate where applicable. Send the CV and scanned copies of relevant documents through email to [email protected] and a copy to [email protected] . Ensure the application is sent on or before 15 October 2026 . Attend the Walk-in-Interview on 16 October 2026 at 11.00 AM at the venue. Report at the venue 1 hour prior to the interview time carrying original documents and copies of qualifications, degree, NET certificate, experience certificate, latest caste/EWS certificate, and two recent passport size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV) Educational qualifications (marks sheets and degree certificates) NET certificate / SLET / SET certificate / Ph.D. degree documents Experience certificate (if applicable) Latest caste certificate / EWS certificate (where applicable) Two recent passport size photographs Original documents/certificates for verification during walk-in-interview

content_sections.heading: CTUAP Guest Faculty Important Instructions

faq.question: Q1. What is CTUAP Guest Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment notification issued by the Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh for engaging Guest Faculty in the Department of Computer Science on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Guest Faculty post in the Department of Computer Science (1 UR and 1 SC).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply via email?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the CV and scanned documents via email is 15 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in-interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in-interview is scheduled for 16 October 2026 at 11.00 AM, and candidates must report 1 hour before the interview time.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree with 55% marks in a relevant subject along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree, or possess a Ph.D. from a foreign university ranked in the top 500.
